transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you. Could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I'm here because... well, my husband's family has been doing things. Quietly. For months now. They're messing with our money, and our good name. I see it when little billing errors show up at work, or when people at church suddenly act funny toward me. No matter what records anyone pulls up to try and explain it away, I know it ties back to them.
Aside from the things you've noticed with your husband's family, have you been hearing or seeing things that others around you do not seem to notice?
No. ... I don't hear things, if that's what you're getting at. I just see what's actually happening.
Have you experienced any periods where your mood felt unusually high, energetic, or conversely, extremely low and hopeless for weeks at a time?
No. ... I don't have anything like that. My mood is fine. I just... go to work and do what I need to do.
